Subject: SF restaurant buyout - initial plan and attachments

Hi all —

Quick summary: Blue Horizon has confirmed an executive dinner on Thu Aug 12 (40 guests, private buyout) and would like a single-kitchen service (no external food trucks). They flagged two priorities: (1) clear allergen labeling for every plated item, and (2) a handful of seated VIPs with strict dietary needs (listed below).

Attachments: seating-diagram-v2.pdf (draft), prelim-menu.xlsx (menu with provisional plating and pricing).

Ask list:
- Chef Marco: can you confirm you can run a full buyout for 40 pax that evening and provide a kitchen allergen matrix we can share with BH? Also need timing for plated courses and whether you can do a two-choice entree service for VIPs.
- Terra Hall Events: confirm load-in window, kitchen access hours, and whether your in-house staff will handle wine service or if we need to bring a sommelier.
- Sean/Marissa/Vivek: I need dietary confirmation on the three VIPs (Cecilia will share names) by EOD Wed Aug 4 so we can finalize the menu with the chef.

Thanks — Tessa

--

Subject: Re: SF restaurant buyout - initial plan and attachments

Tessa — thanks for the note. Oak Kitchen can do a full buyout on Thu Aug 12 and we have a dedicated line for special-diet prep (gluten-free/vegan/nut-free segregation).

I attached our kitchen allergen matrix (oakkitchen-allergen-sheet.xlsx) and a suggested 3-course sample menu below. Two-choice entrees are doable; we recommend pre-punching selections at check-in for plated timing.

Sample menu (can be modified):
- Starter: Heirloom tomato salad (GF, V optional)
- Main (guest choice):
  * Pan-seared halibut, brown butter, caper salsa (contains fish, dairy)
  * Tarragon roast chicken, citrus jus (contains dairy if buttered)
  * Wild mushroom farrotto (V, contains gluten unless subbed)
- Dessert: Lemon olive oil cake (contains egg, gluten) + vegan chocolate option (V, GF)

Logistics notes:
- We need a 3-hour on-site prep window and 90 minutes for plated service turnover.
- Access: chef needs direct kitchen access from 3:00 PM; staging area for serviceware required.

I'll update the allergen sheet with line-item cross-contamination notes once you confirm final menu.

Best,
Marco
Chef/Owner, Oak Kitchen

- Timing: prefer plated service at 7:00 PM (guests arrive 6:30 PM). Marco — please confirm you can do plated service for 40 with a 7:00 start.
- AV/brief: they want a short 10-min welcome from Cecilia at 7:45 and a 5-min product thank-you at 8:15. Need confirmation from Terra Hall on mic + handheld and whether we can run a short slide deck from a laptop.
